people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
translations.bsb: and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked. But Jesus gave no answer.
translations.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
translations.asv: and he entered into the Praetorium again, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
